quote: When you wake up in the morning, tell yourself: the people I deal with today will be meddling, ungrateful, arrogant, dishonest, jealous, and surly. They are this way because they cannot tell good from evil. But I have seen the beauty of good, and the ugliness of evil, and have recognized that the wrongdoer has a nature related to my own.
author: Marcus Aurelius
reflection: Before your first difficult conversation today, recall that the person frustrating you is operating from the same capacity for confusion you yourself have felt — and let that recognition replace irritation with something more useful.
